There is a misconception between evolution, and adaptation. 

The body of an any species of creature does not evolve, it adapts to its environment. 

Primates did not evolve into human beings. The two are not the same. The gene expressions between the species have entirely different coding. 

It’s a bit like saying domestic cats evolved from lions and tigers, no they did not, the two are completely different species and have many different gene expressions, that make them entirely different species. Meaning a big cat, could never detransition into a domestic cat, or vice versa, but a pig can transition into a wild boar because it’s the same animal, if left to its own devices in the wild. 

As demonstrated above, the same species can also transform from one thing to another. 

Eg: a caterpillar into a butterfly, that is not evolution, the caterpillar has the exact genetic code as the butterfly, it’s just completing its life cycle, that is not evolution, that’s just just what caterpillars do. 

The fact that humans or any other species develops adaptations that can be seen and observed to develop or revert back to a baseline when they are no longer in that environment proves that this is not evolution, it’s an adaptation, like an athlete’s body developing higher cardio output, more muscle and bone density when put under harder work, or developing calluses on the hands and feet during hard labour. 

One species did not evolve into another species, their gene expressions adapted overtime, or during the course of several generations to adapt to their current environment. 

You can move your health markers by thinking, eating, drinking, and or being in a negative or positive environment, which has been proven to have a measurable biological effect, this is also an adaptation, it is not evolution. 

Evolution is a proven pseudo science, to explain something very simple which is adaptations. The two are not the same.
